meta.name: context-building
meta.description: Assemble a minimal, high-signal execution context bundle from already-retrieved memory, governed artefacts, and applicable rules. Activate after memory-retrieve and before any reasoning or execution skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动组装关键上下文信息，提升Agent推理效率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建需要高效执行上下文的Agent系统
copy.tagline_en: Assemble key context automatically to boost agent reasoning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building agent systems that need efficient execution context

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先审查已有的记忆和规则，去重后按“目标→制品→标准→规则→记忆”的顺序打包成一个精简的上下文，交给下一步使用。
howto.when: 在 Claude 从多个记忆文件中检索信息后，开始推理或执行任务前自动触发，适用于复杂任务或上下文碎片化时。

say.text: 帮我整理刚才检索到的上下文，准备开始写代码。
say.note: 触发整理当前记忆和规则

say.text: 把故事和验收标准打包成执行上下文，过滤掉无关信息。
say.note: 明确要求打包制品和约束

say.text: 基于现有的记忆和规则，生成一个最小上下文包。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans existing memories and rules, deduplicates them, and assembles them into a compact execution context bundle following the order: objective, artefacts, acceptance criteria, rules, memory. It then passes this bundle to the next step.
howto.when_en: Triggers automatically after memory retrieval and before reasoning or execution, especially when context is fragmented or multiple memory sources are involved.

say_en.text: Bundle the retrieved context and prepare for coding.
say_en.note: Triggers context assembly for coding tasks

say_en.text: Pack the story and acceptance criteria into an execution context, filtering irrelevant info.
say_en.note: Requests a focused bundle with artefacts and constraints

say_en.text: Generate a minimal context bundle from current memories and rules.
